verdict.rationale: A live probe found an llms.txt at developers.zoom.us/llms.txt (HTTP 200), with an API catalog and an MCP section. A second probe confirmed that Scribe docs are served as autogenerated markdown (.md), and the Scribe doc URLs throughout the pack (fast-mode.md, live-mode.md, batch-mode.md, custom-vocabulary.md) are markdown too. This gives agents a clear entry point and machine-readable docs. missing for 10: confirmation that the llms.txt indexes Scribe-specific pages (it appears to cover all Zoom docs), independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs successfully.
